reports.phase: Initial boot with no defaults file
reports.scope: Japanese NES list/order, both games launch/video/audio/controls; STAGE5G and DEFAULTS MISSING; Dr.Mario CSV ON/WEAK/STANDARD and Pac-Man builtin OFF; IDs/STORE RESET/SAVED/FRAME ACK and OSD1 return normal

reports.user_report: 1-3正常。項目の順序はOSDに表示される順序に揃えてください
reports.phase: System defaults initial boot and CSV priority
reports.scope: Japanese NES list/order, Dr.Mario and Pac-Man launch/video/audio/controls normal; Dr.Mario retains CSV ON/WEAK/STANDARD; Pac-Man uses SYSTEM ON/STANDARD/WEAK; STAGE5G, ROM IDs, STORE RESET, SAVE SAVED, DEFAULTS OK and FRAME ACK confirmed. No setting change, Reset or SAVE requested.

reports.phase: User override, system Reset preview cancellation and OSD regression
reports.scope: Pac-Man manually saved ON/STRONG/STANDARD once; SAVE stayed open and SAVED; relaunch restored USER/USER and values with FRAME ACK. Reset preview selected ON/STANDARD/WEAK; both X and Y discarded it and restored saved user values. Five OSD positions including new DEFAULTS row, OSD1 exclusion/centering, input blocking and all-button release wait passed. No extra SAVE requested; PC verification of generation and file integrity remains pending.

reports.phase: Global inheritance, user priority, Reset SAVE and power cycle
reports.scope: Japanese list/order and both games video/audio/controls normal. Pac-Man initially retained USER ON/STRONG/STANDARD above global defaults. Reset preview inherited global ON/WEAK/STRONG from blank NES row; one SAVE stayed open and SAVED. Relaunch and power cycle restored GLOBAL/RESET/SAVED with ON/WEAK/STRONG, expected ROM ID, DEFAULTS OK and FRAME ACK. Dr.Mario retained CSV ON/WEAK/STANDARD, RESET/SAVED, expected ROM ID, DEFAULTS OK and FRAME ACK. PC verification of the new Reset generation and unchanged files remains pending.

reports.phase: Invalid unselected-system row rejects the entire defaults file
reports.scope: Japanese NES list/order and both games launch/video/audio/controls normal. Dr.Mario retained SAVED/CSV/ON/WEAK/STANDARD/RESET/FRAME ACK/ROM ID 7623dffd with DEFAULTS BAD FILE. Pac-Man used SAVED/DEFAULT/OFF/OFF/OFF/RESET/FRAME ACK/ROM ID ebbb19bf with DEFAULTS BAD FILE, rejecting otherwise-valid global and NES rows too. No setting change, Reset or SAVE requested.

reports.phase: User save and Reset under invalid defaults
reports.scope: Dr.Mario manually saved ON/STRONG/WEAK once; SAVE stayed open and SAVED, then relaunch restored USER/USER, values, expected ROM ID, DEFAULTS BAD FILE and FRAME ACK. Reset preview used CSV ON/WEAK/STANDARD; both X/Y discarded it and restored saved user values. Reset then SAVE once and relaunch restored CSV/RESET/SAVED and recommended values with BAD FILE/FRAME ACK. Pac-Man repeated Reset retained SAVED/DEFAULT/all OFF/RESET/expected ROM ID/BAD FILE/FRAME ACK with no SAVE, as the same Reset mode was already persisted. Both games video/audio/controls normal. Record generations and unrelated-file integrity await final PC audit.

reports.phase: Final boot after test defaults removal
reports.scope: Japanese NES list/order and both games launch/video/audio/controls normal. Dr.Mario restored SAVED/CSV/ON/WEAK/STANDARD/RESET/FRAME ACK/ROM ID 7623dffd/DEFAULTS MISSING. Pac-Man restored SAVED/DEFAULT/OFF/OFF/OFF/RESET/FRAME ACK/ROM ID ebbb19bf/DEFAULTS MISSING. No value change, Reset or SAVE requested.

limitations: Verified on current Console138K/NES and two recorded ROMs. Eleven host scripts and firmware build passed. System/global/blank inheritance, CSV/user priorities, Reset preview/SAVE/X/Y cancellation, OSD layout/input, whole-file rejection and CSV/user/builtin fallback, staged SD audits and test-file cleanup plus final normal boot passed. Other cores and USB-volume hardware behavior and storage I/O fault classes are not newly hardware-validated. Stage5e/5f contain prior denied-write/recovery tests. No raw-sector identity claim; initial monolithic stage5 boot-failure root cause remains undetermined.
